nodes.title: saebase/__init__.py
nodes.description: SAEBase: Hydra-driven framework for LLM SAE evaluation.

nodes.title: saebase/api/__init__.py
nodes.description: Stable entrypoints for SAEBase Phase B public research API. For actual SAE/model checkpoint loading use ``load_registered()``. The API also accepts custom model/SAE objects and needs no downloads for small tests.

nodes.title: saebase/api/component_analysis.py
nodes.description: Block-level residual contributions from actual supported hook locations. These are residual-state differences, not direct logit attribution or independent causal effects. The calculation explicitly requires all three hook points to be available in the selected execution backend.

nodes.title: saebase/api/components.py
nodes.description: Evidence-backed block, attention-head and MLP-neuron contributions. Keeps block-residual differences distinct from native projected components; both original numerical implementations and contracts are retained.

nodes.title: saebase/api/features.py
nodes.description: SAE feature capture, editing, and downstream behavioral evaluation. Feature editing uses `h_new = h + decode(z_new) - decode(z)` where `z` comes from `encode(h)`. The untouched activation content, including the residual `h - decode(z)`, is retained. The decoder is called through its actual API so biases and its internal scaling are treated consistently. SAEs

nodes.title: saebase/api/fine_components.py
nodes.description: Actual TransformerLens attention-head and MLP-neuron residual contributions. Unlike block-level residual differences, these are independently computed projection vectors for each attention head and post-nonlinearity MLP neuron. Biases are returned separately. Unsupported architectures fail closed.

nodes.title: saebase/api/metadata.py
nodes.description: Stable, serializable provenance of an SAE evaluation site.

nodes.title: saebase/api/model.py
nodes.description: Backend-neutral, one-prompt activation and model-intervention interface. Capture/patch are deliberately scoped to an explicit model site and a single prompt. This contract prevents ambiguity about batch and token alignment. Supported adapters: local TransformerLens HookedTransformer/TransformerBridge, HFHooksModel and compatible implementations of their docu

nodes.title: saebase/api/nnsight_local.py
nodes.description: Optional local NNsight execution over an existing NNsight-wrapped model. No NDIF, remote execution, vLLM worker, implicit model download or automatic device selection is performed here. Use an existing NNsight wrapper or call `from_torch` explicitly. Module locations are exact user-selected paths and the wrapper rejects ambiguous or unsafe attribute names.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/__init__.py
nodes.description: M3 reproducible SAE benchmarking: validation, planning, execution and reporting.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/adapters/__init__.py
nodes.description: External benchmark adapters preserve upstream definitions and protocols.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/adapters/custom_saebench.py
nodes.description: P4 bounded custom-SAE evaluations using original SAEBench Core/Sparse Probing. Supports actually loaded registered SAE objects, not hand-made metric emulation. A bounded subprocess is mandatory before any native suite.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/adapters/localization.py
nodes.description: Localize M3 adapter: validated full input grids and checksum-bound curve artifacts. Exact/paired scope estimators remain in the independent sae_localize package. Metric rows contain scalar summaries; full curves and assignments are artifacts.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/adapters/papers.py
nodes.description: Invoke unchanged SAR/RSS paper estimators via existing SAEBase interfaces.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/adapters/saebench.py
nodes.description: Strict importer for native SAEBench Core / Sparse Probing JSON outputs. Does not reproduce upstream math. Native SAEBench must run independently with matching checkpoints, samples and protocol before validated comparison claims.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/metrics/__init__.py
nodes.description: Metric implementations read immutable M1/M2 measurements.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/metrics/core.py
nodes.description: Exact token-weighted SAE health metrics on M1 activation/code rows.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/metrics/intervention.py
nodes.description: Read M2 provenance-verified raw measurement rows without re-running forwards.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/metrics/reconstruction.py
nodes.description: Reconstruction behavioral NLL and loss recovered with explicit ablation reference.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/native_comparisons.py
nodes.description: P4 native-SAEBench pilot runner and provenance-aware SAE comparison. Reuses original upstream Core/Sparse-Probing code; native JSON import is not a substitute for running the upstream evaluators on real checkpoints.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/planner.py
nodes.description: Deterministic DAG and explicit, conservative resource estimates.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/registry.py
nodes.description: Metric metadata only. Mathematical estimators reside in their own source packages.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/report.py
nodes.description: Portable CSV and single-file HTML; no network or CDN dependencies.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/results.py
nodes.description: Atomic, append-only metric ledger with stable keys and a verified manifest.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/runner.py
nodes.description: M3 execution: M1 activation/code reuse, M2 measurements, metric adapters. No model is loaded until `real=True`; no external source is downloaded.

nodes.title: saebase/benchmarks/schema.py
nodes.description: Versioned, deliberately strict benchmark/metric contracts. The resolved configuration is a deterministic identity; heavyweight model loading and external estimator imports are never performed during validation.

nodes.title: saebase/cfg/config_validate.py
nodes.description: Hydra config validation for the tasks included with SAEBase Phase A.

nodes.title: saebase/cfg/contracts.py
nodes.description: Generic cfg-level assertions (no hard-coded plugin names).

nodes.title: saebase/circuits/__init__.py
nodes.description: Source-backed circuit graphs and causal feature interventions.

nodes.title: saebase/circuits/clt_intervention.py
nodes.description: Execute a real Gemma Scope 2 CLT feature edit across downstream model layers. This changes live PyTorch module outputs, not just a saved graph JSON or cross-layer decoder tensor. Requires exact input/output site mappings and the original model/transcoder identity. No arbitrary pickles are loaded.

nodes.title: saebase/circuits/graph.py
nodes.description: P6 native circuit-tracer CLI wrapper and typed graph data preservation. Native attribution must actually run upstream. Pruning, node annotations and a drawn graph cannot stand in for the gradient computation or intervention.

nodes.title: saebase/circuits/transcoder_intervention.py
nodes.description: Actual source-bound circuit feature edits via a native Scope 2 transcoder. The original output is changed by decode(z_new) - decode(z), preserving everything outside the chosen transcoder feature. This is not a proof that a traced circuit is unique. Requires a real PyTorch forward and exact hooks.

nodes.title: saebase/cli.py

nodes.title: saebase/cli_compat.py

nodes.title: saebase/tools/check_documentation.py
nodes.description: Check local Markdown links in SAEBase's developer-facing documentation. No network access or third-party Markdown package is required. External URLs and same-page fragments are not checked by this script.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/check_env.py
nodes.description: Explain dependency availability without loading a GPU runtime or a model.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/check_installed_wheel.py
nodes.description: Install the built wheel without dependencies, then smoke-test it outside the source tree. The Python executing this script supplies already-installed runtime dependencies. No network or model weights are required. A missing optional model package is fine.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/check_new_python_quality.py
nodes.description: Gate newly added Python files without reformatting existing research code.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/check_sdist_roundtrip.py
nodes.description: Rebuild an SAEBase wheel from its sdist in a separate temporary directory.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/generate_model_support.py
nodes.description: Render and verify current-main model and SAE support from committed evidence.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m0_reference_smoke.py
nodes.description: M0 real-weight reference: verified Pythia + SAE capture, patch and provenance. The CLI uses published checkpoints (downloads are opt-in). Nothing in this module claims real-checkpoint acceptance unless those weights are actually loaded and its numerical checks succeed. The pure record_reference function is intentionally testable with small deterministic mode

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m1_real_smoke.py
nodes.description: Opt-in real Pythia M1 cache acceptance compared to the successful M0 run. Requires the M0 GitHub Actions artifact plus access to public model/SAE weights. Never claims real checkpoint success from synthetic tests or missing artifacts.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m2_batch.py
nodes.description: SAEBase JSON feature-intervention experiment entrypoint (batch + optional token steering). Dry-run never loads pretrained weights, imports SAE Lens, or creates artifacts. Actual execution is opt-in with --real; it may download public checkpoints.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m2_real_smoke.py
nodes.description: Real M2 batch + M1-cache + M0-reference smoke (Pythia 70M, CPU). Downloads public checkpoints on demand. Success evidence is never created from fake model weights or from a synthetic fixture alone.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m3_benchmark.py
nodes.description: Versioned SAE benchmark CLI. Dry-run never downloads checkpoints.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m3_native_saebench_smoke.py
nodes.description: Run *native upstream* SAEBench Core and Sparse Probing, bounded to one CPU SAE. No metric estimator is copied into SAEBase. The upstream repo must be an editable installation and have commit 8042bb3828c6340da8d12062324e92b2077c571c. The two native protocols use the same Pythia model and same SAE checkpoint, with their own documented dataset and metric config

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m4_ground_truth.py
nodes.description: Run independent analytical and known-factor SAR/RSS ground-truth controls.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m4_reliability.py
nodes.description: Audit a completed SAE benchmark from its verified activation and intervention caches.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m5_release_gate.py
nodes.description: Fail closed before publishing 0.2.0 distribution and checksums.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/m5_release_matrix.py
nodes.description: Real multi-checkpoint release matrix: deterministic preflight and verified execution.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_a_benchmark.py
nodes.description: Real Qwen3.5-2B SAEBase Benchmark and Reliability acceptance. Run after (or separately from) phase_a_verify on a suitable CPU/GPU runner. Downloads genuine model+SAE weights and produces checksum-bound M3/M4 evidence.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_a_sae_only.py
nodes.description: Download and check genuine Phase A pretrained SAE weights without the base LLM. SAE-only success is not model-SAE pair acceptance. No model is loaded.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_a_verify.py
nodes.description: Real-weight acceptance for SAEBase Phase A model/SAE coverage. Run one entry at a time. No synthetic fixtures count as verified checkpoints. Requires the original model and SAE weights, and often a CUDA GPU / HF access.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_bc_aggregate.py
nodes.description: Validate and aggregate authentic Stage B/C CPU SAE-only evidence artifacts. Input directories contain extracted JSON files from GitHub Actions artifacts. A corrected checkpoint may supersede exactly one previously BLOCKED observation, without re-running unrelated successful SAE downloads.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_bc_cpu_benchmark.py
nodes.description: Genuine CPU-only M3 Benchmark and M4 Reliability acceptance for three Stage B pairs.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_bc_cpu_pair.py
nodes.description: Real CPU model/SAE acceptance for Stage B's three small ungated models. Test actual checkpoint capture, reconstruction, identity hook patch and one non-trivial feature intervention. Do not load larger Phase D models here.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_bc_cpu_sae.py
nodes.description: Check a genuinely downloaded Stage B/C SAE checkpoint on CPU. No language-model weights are loaded. A passed SAE-only record must not be presented as successful end-to-end model/intervention verification.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_bc_matrix.py
nodes.description: Inspect the Stage B/C model, SAE and multilayer checkpoint matrix offline.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_bc_source_metadata.py
nodes.description: Remote source file and SHA metadata checks without downloading SAE tensors. This is an upstream existence check; it is never a real-weight acceptance.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_d_benchmark.py
nodes.description: Stage D real M3/M4 runner for any catalog-selected SAE site. Builds a BenchmarkConfig with registered metric IDs, freezes token IDs, runs native M3, then M4 against stored activations (no second model load for audit). ``--population`` requires the frozen corpus in ``conf/coverage/stage_d_population.jsonl`` with ≥64 independent evaluation groups. Feature IDs

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_d_matrix.py
nodes.description: Resumable Stage D orchestrator over the 48-site catalog. Schedules one model family at a time, skips proven passes under ``--resume``, and writes environment / status / attempt ledgers under ``--output``.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_d_verify.py
nodes.description: Stage D single-site GPU/CPU model–SAE pair acceptance. Supports every catalog profile and selected layer. Writes checksum-bound acceptance JSON under ``<output>/acceptance/<model>/<sae>/L<layer>.json``.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/phase_d_verify_evidence.py
nodes.description: Read-only auditor for Stage D compact evidence vs raw runs and status. Fails when: - status.json is not exactly the 48 catalog keys - a counted M3/M4 summary lacks its raw run directory / manifests - compact metric numbers disagree with metrics.jsonl - checksums.sha256 entries do not match file contents

nodes.title: saebase/tools/release_candidate.py
nodes.description: Fail-closed, version-independent SOFTWARE release candidate verification. This program validates distribution provenance, not the scientific validity of new models, SAEs or experimental results. The historical M5 v0.2.0 release gate remains separate and immutable.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/sae_prepare_prompts.py
nodes.description: Prepare validated SimpleCopying prompts for the standalone Pythia SAE demo. Works as `python saebase/tools/sae_prepare_prompts.py` and as `python -m saebase.tools.sae_prepare_prompts`.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/stage_d_archive.py
nodes.description: Verify and package Stage D evidence without rerunning a model or SAE. Two deliberately distinct outputs: compact: the 200 committed evidence files, supporting provenance and verifier raw: only original GPU archives whose stored byte hashes have been checked The compact bundle is never presented as the original M3/M4 raw run cache. Uses Python standard librar

nodes.title: saebase/tools/verify_distribution.py
nodes.description: Validate built SAEBase wheel/sdist contents without installing optional packages.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_gpu06.py
nodes.description: Work Plan 09 GPU-06: interp-engine/vLLM and reference steering on one RTX 5070. Reference steering uses the SAEBase full-prefix oracle. Accelerated backends are experimental and are not enabled by default. Raw prompt text is not written to the public report.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_gpu06_align.py
nodes.description: Align eager interp-engine with SAEBase on one torch, then compare edits. Residual readouts, token positions, and bf16 logits are compared directly. decode_residuals is not used: it is a final-norm lens, not the model logits. Prompt text is not written.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_gpu06_vllm_forward.py
nodes.description: One real vLLM forward on the RTX 5070. CUDA_HOME must be a CUDA >= 12.9 toolkit before FlashInfer is imported. The process records whether generation returns tokens. Prompt text is not written.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_gpu06_vllm_parity.py
nodes.description: vLLM capture, identity, and generation against the SAEBase residual. CUDA_HOME is set before vLLM imports. Attention is Triton and the sampler is native, because that is the combination that completes a forward on this GPU. Prompt text is not written.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_gpu06_worker.py
nodes.description: Run inside the interp-engine environment. Records what actually executes.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_gpu_pilot.py
nodes.description: Work Plan 09 focused RTX 5070 pilot for PR #44. Measures the pinned SAEBASE_ROOT checkout. Raw prompts and token ids stay under the private run directory. This is an engineering pilot, not a 48-site sweep and not a substitute for the Stage D 64-group population.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_identity_base.py
nodes.description: Identity replay on the pinned base commit, kept separate from candidate diffs. Uses the base tree's BatchEngine. Same-width and cross-width errors are both recorded. Prompt text is not written.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_identity_width.py
nodes.description: Separate identity-replay width from candidate regressions. The pilot baseline forward uses sample_batch=8 and the old identity replay used microbatch=4. This script reports both widths on the current candidate. Prompt text is not written.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_layer_trace_hf.py
nodes.description: Per-layer SAEBase and eager-interp residuals, plus one serial Qwen profile. Token ids come from the existing GPU-06 reference file. This script does not write prompt text or token ids.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_layer_trace_vllm.py
nodes.description: Capture every vLLM residual and compare it with the SAEBase layer trace. CUDA_HOME is set before vLLM imports. Configurations are selected with --config and are not enabled as a SAEBase backend. Prompt text and token ids are not written.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_qwen_hashcache_timing.py
nodes.description: Time the serial Qwen workload after the state-hash cache. No prompt text.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_qwen_kernel_probe.py
nodes.description: See which attention/matmul settings make a Qwen batch match batch-size 1.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_qwen_optin_parity.py
nodes.description: Engine-level parity for opt-in HF run_batch after the row-wise kernel fix. Compares enable_hf_masked_batch True against the default single-example path on equal-length and mixed-length groups. Does not change the default.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_qwen_phase_profile.py
nodes.description: Phase timing for one serial Qwen engine run. No prompt text or token ids.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_qwen_stage_diff.py
nodes.description: Compare single-example and masked HF forwards on Qwen, stage by stage. Prints lengths and numeric errors only. Prompt text stays in the private pilot file.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan09_qwen_stream_probe.py
nodes.description: Time independent Qwen forwards against one fused batch, and check exact agreement.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan10_gpu.py
nodes.description: Work Plan 10 RTX 5070 check. Does not write prompt text or token ids.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan11_acceptance_gpu.py
nodes.description: Mandatory RTX 5070 end-to-end, clean-KV and vLLM SAE validation. The CPU-only CI tests never invoke this script. All GPU claims must come from its real per-run JSON and the referenced exact code / checkpoint revisions. Examples: python saebase/tools/workplan11_acceptance_gpu.py e2e python saebase/tools/workplan11_acceptance_gpu.py kv --steps 8 python saebase

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan11_fast_steering_gpu.py
nodes.description: RTX 5070 benchmarks for *implemented* cached SAE steering backends. Modes: hf-reference: old clean-full-prefix SAE ablation, no KV (reproduction baseline) hf-live: one prefill + one HF KV forward/token, dynamic SAE re-encode vllm: interp-engine vLLM cached generation + fixed decoder feature direction vllm-static: static-tap graph variant, if RTX 5070 VRAM pe

nodes.title: saebase/tools/workplan11_qwen_suffix.py
nodes.description: RTX 5070 parity and timing for opt-in block-suffix replay. Public prompts only. Raw series go to experiments/performance/workplan11/, which is gitignored. The committed report must quote this output rather than invent it.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp12_autointerpret.py
nodes.description: Run local SAE feature auto-interpretation on real reviewed activation saebase.examples. No Hugging Face model download, external API request, public upload or automatic approval. Outputs a private hypothesis with held-out diagnostics.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp12_p1_smoke.py
nodes.description: Bounded P1 real-checkpoint smoke, opt-in only; no benchmark expansion.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp12_p2_capture.py
nodes.description: Opt-in real SAE token feature capture; data remain private until reviewed.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp12_p8_acceptance.py
nodes.description: P8 independent acceptance report from actual 50-item evidence and raw archive.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp12_private_worker.py
nodes.description: Run one real WP12 private SAE job on your own authenticated GPU host. One iteration only. Does not launch a public service, download datasets implicitly, or simulate an inference result. Configure OPENSAE_PRIVATE_DATA and OPENSAE_ENABLE_PRIVATE_JOBS=1 before invoking.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp13_prepare_public_bundle.py
nodes.description: Prepare a SMALL WP13 handoff or a locally approved real Research Lab bundle. By default this only indexes source-bound private trace metadata. It never publishes prompt texts or activation arrays. An optional explicit reviewed release builds actual SQLite/trace artifacts IN PLACE on the source host.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp13_stage_live03.py
nodes.description: Convert a measured LIVE-03 summary into optional reviewed public intervention cards. No GPU is run. By default this validates and prints a *private* count; it does not publish. Source results and model/SAE SHA are never manufactured.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp15_import_gemma_graph.py
nodes.description: Import the real Gemma-2-2B circuit-tracer graph and keep a browser-sized copy. The raw .pt file stays on disk. This script reads the official frontend JSON, checks node identities, and keeps the strongest edges that fit the Lab view.

nodes.title: saebase/tools/wp15_steer.py
nodes.description: Local generation-time SAE steering. Records continuations and per-step shifts. This is greedy or sampled token generation, not a teacher-forced logit card. Prompt text is read from a local file and is not printed.

nodes.title: saebase/vllm_backend/__init__.py
nodes.description: Compat re-export. Prefer ``saebase.generate``.

nodes.title: saebase/vllm_backend/fast_steering.py
nodes.description: Fast SAE decoder-direction steering through interp-engine KV-cached generation. This uses interp-engine's actual steer() + generate_stream() APIs, including per-request vLLM steering and static CUDA-graph taps where available. Fixed decoder-direction addition is NOT dynamic tokenwise SAE ablation: use the separate HF live-SAE cached implementation when the c

nodes.title: saebase/vllm_backend/generate.py
nodes.description: Compatibility exports for generation; sampling is explicit in standalone SAEBase. Legacy SAEReasoning protocol sampling constants are in its research workspace, so callers must supply the settings when using standalone SAEBase.

nodes.title: saebase/vllm_backend/sae_interventions.py
nodes.description: Real SAE feature editing on the upstream interp-engine vLLM hook backend. Uses interp-engine's own per-request read/write taps; SAE codes and the residual-preserving delta are computed with SAEBase's original operator. This is an opt-in backend-native experiment, never a silent replacement for HF/SAEBase. vLLM numerical equivalence must be measured separatel

nodes.title: tasks/__init__.py
nodes.description: SAEBase task registration. Phase A bundles the SAE activation-health task.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/__init__.py
nodes.description: benchmark registered task.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/activation_health.py
nodes.description: Activation-health evaluation: last-token hook + SAE encode/decode.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/analyze.py
nodes.description: Prompt → hook activation → SAE encode/decode analysis.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/__init__.py
nodes.description: M3 reproducible SAE benchmarking: validation, planning, execution and reporting.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/adapters/__init__.py
nodes.description: External benchmark adapters preserve upstream definitions and protocols.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/adapters/localization.py
nodes.description: Localize M3 adapter: validated full input grids and checksum-bound curve artifacts. Exact/paired scope estimators remain in the independent sae_localize package. Metric rows contain scalar summaries; full curves and assignments are artifacts.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/adapters/papers.py
nodes.description: Invoke unchanged SAR/RSS paper estimators via existing SAEBase interfaces.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/adapters/saebench.py
nodes.description: Strict importer for native SAEBench Core / Sparse Probing JSON outputs. Does not reproduce upstream math. Native SAEBench must run independently with matching checkpoints, samples and protocol before validated comparison claims.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/metrics/__init__.py
nodes.description: Metric implementations read immutable M1/M2 measurements.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/metrics/core.py
nodes.description: Exact token-weighted SAE health metrics on M1 activation/code rows.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/metrics/intervention.py
nodes.description: Read M2 provenance-verified raw measurement rows without re-running forwards.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/metrics/reconstruction.py
nodes.description: Reconstruction behavioral NLL and loss recovered with explicit ablation reference.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/planner.py
nodes.description: Deterministic DAG and explicit, conservative resource estimates.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/registry.py
nodes.description: Metric metadata only. Mathematical estimators reside in their own source packages.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/report.py
nodes.description: Portable CSV and single-file HTML; no network or CDN dependencies.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/results.py
nodes.description: Atomic, append-only metric ledger with stable keys and a verified manifest.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/runner.py
nodes.description: M3 execution: M1 activation/code reuse, M2 measurements, metric adapters. No model is loaded until `real=True`; no external source is downloaded.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/backend/schema.py
nodes.description: Versioned, deliberately strict benchmark/metric contracts. The resolved configuration is a deterministic identity; heavyweight model loading and external estimator imports are never performed during validation.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/controlled_inputs.py
nodes.description: Complete Boolean input designs and provenance for SAE activation experiments. Controlled input states are external model inputs, not SAE feature edits. Existing SAEBase SampleRecord and activation/code storage schemas are unchanged.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/extensions/__init__.py
nodes.description: Explicit third-party extension API for models, SAEs and benchmark metrics. To load installed entry-point packages, opt in to discover_extensions(names). Importing SAEBase never imports arbitrary third-party extension packages.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/extensions/contracts.py
nodes.description: Versioned contracts for explicitly installed third-party SAEBase extensions. Only an explicit registration or a requested entry point discovery may load external Python code. Declaring a source is NOT checkpoint verification.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/extensions/metrics.py
nodes.description: Execution and source-integrity checks for explicit third-party metrics.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/extensions/registry.py
nodes.description: Explicit, collision-safe extension registration and entry-point discovery.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/extensions/runtime.py
nodes.description: Explicit third-party model/SAE loading with shape and site validation.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/health_results.py
nodes.description: Summaries and optional JSON writers for SAE evaluations.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/integrations/__init__.py
nodes.description: Paper-method bridges built on SAEBase's public model/SAE interfaces. SAR, RSS and Input Localization estimators remain in their original independent repositories. Supply their modules to the respective functions, or import them using ``load_paper_module`` from an explicit local checkout.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/integrations/localization.py
nodes.description: Bridge SAEBase capture/code caches to the original SAE Input Localization estimators. The mathematical estimators live in the independent sae_localize package. This module prepares complete Boolean input grids and preserves their lineage. It does not turn SAE feature ablation into an input-factor intervention.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/integrations/rss.py
nodes.description: RSS feature response acquisition through SAEBase's public capture API. Selection and held-out variants are disjoint before any metric is computed. The only RSS metric implementations used are supplied by the original rss.py.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/integrations/sar.py
nodes.description: Evaluate SAR coalitions using SAEBase feature capture and model patching. Sampling and SAR metrics are imported from the *unchanged* paper's sar.py. One coalition means removing absent selected codes and keeping all other activation content fixed, including the original reconstruction residual.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/integrations/sources.py
nodes.description: Load a paper's unmodified estimator from a user-provided local checkout.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/native/benchmarks.py
nodes.description: P4 native-SAEBench pilot runner and provenance-aware SAE comparison. Reuses original upstream Core/Sparse-Probing code; native JSON import is not a substitute for running the upstream evaluators on real checkpoints.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/native/custom_saebench.py
nodes.description: P4 bounded custom-SAE evaluations using original SAEBench Core/Sparse Probing. Supports actually loaded registered SAE objects, not hand-made metric emulation. A bounded subprocess is mandatory before any native suite.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/operation.py
nodes.description: Concrete benchmark task implementation; SAEBase supplies reusable primitives.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/pipeline_checks.py
nodes.description: Preflight checks for the Hydra ``sae`` evaluation task.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/release/__init__.py
nodes.description: M5 two-family publication matrix and release evidence (no model training).

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/release/gates.py
nodes.description: M5 source, distribution, and real matrix verification for GitHub release gates.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/release/planner.py
nodes.description: No-download release matrix preflight; never claims unverified availability.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/release/runner.py
nodes.description: M5 real-weight matrix, M1/M2/M3/M4 reuse, verified restart and metrics. No external checkpoints are bundled, no score is collapsed across metrics, and import-only/report-only modes never load model weights.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/release/schema.py
nodes.description: Strict, immutable and reproducible M5 release matrix schema.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/__init__.py
nodes.description: M4 reliability audit. Never modifies a benchmark metric or its raw observations.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/bootstrap.py
nodes.description: Deterministic percentile cluster bootstrap and strictly paired SAE comparisons.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/controls.py
nodes.description: Analytic negative controls and only mathematically valid invariances.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/discriminability.py
nodes.description: Known controllable degradation, paired ground-truth uncertainty and rankings.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/ground_truth.py
nodes.description: Independent synthetic truths for SAE feature factors and dictionary recovery. These fixtures are analytical controls, never claims about learned model SAE features. Calibration chooses a feature matching; test never re-fits it.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/ground_truth_report.py
nodes.description: Deterministic scientific validity controls using original SAR/RSS source files.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/interaction_truth.py
nodes.description: Known-order coalition behaviors and independent orthogonal interaction energy.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/localization.py
nodes.description: Conditional Localize reliability and descriptive cross-SAE comparisons. One complete Boolean factorial grid is ONE input population, not 2**n independent observations. Do not apply M4 prompt-group bootstrap to its states. Finite-pair repetitions assess Monte Carlo estimation stability, not generalization.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/observations.py
nodes.description: Reconstruct M4 observation units from verified M3/M1/M2 artifacts only. No pretrained model loads; no forward passes; original M3 metric rows immutable.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/ranking.py
nodes.description: Pair-aligned ranking stability; never rank contextual SAR/RSS and unrelated metrics.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/report.py
nodes.description: Portable and checksum-verified M4 audit reporting; attaches to M3 HTML.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/resampling.py
nodes.description: Prompt-group cluster resampling with frozen within-group variants.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/rss_truth.py
nodes.description: Selection/held-out known-support RSS fixtures and false-positive controls.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/runner.py
nodes.description: Audit frozen M3 outputs; never calls the model or modifies M3 metrics.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/reliability/schema.py
nodes.description: Immutable grouped evaluation contracts; training seeds are not evaluation seeds.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/stage_d.py
nodes.description: Stage D GPU pair acceptance ledger, scheduling, and numerical protocol. The catalog truth source remains ``conf/coverage/stage_bc.json``. This module adds resumable execution state and the pair-acceptance contract from the Stage D handoff plan. Historical A/B/C evidence is joined, never overwritten.

nodes.title: tasks/benchmark/task.py
nodes.description: SAEBase benchmark task.

nodes.title: tasks/capture/__init__.py
nodes.description: capture registered task.

nodes.title: tasks/capture/explore.py
nodes.description: A real prompt-to-sparse-token-feature capture for the local SAEBase worker. This opt-in Python API records the complete nonzero codes at each token. It is distinct from model generation, feature steering and a public inference service. The returned record is private until reviewed for redistribution.

nodes.title: tasks/capture/operation.py
nodes.description: Concrete capture task implementation; SAEBase supplies reusable primitives.

nodes.title: tasks/capture/task.py
nodes.description: SAEBase live capture task.

nodes.title: tasks/circuits/__init__.py
nodes.description: circuits registered task.

nodes.title: tasks/circuits/backend/circuit_intervene.py
nodes.description: Actual source-bound circuit feature edits via a native Scope 2 transcoder. The original output is changed by decode(z_new) - decode(z), preserving everything outside the chosen transcoder feature. This is not a proof that a traced circuit is unique. Requires a real PyTorch forward and exact hooks.

nodes.title: tasks/circuits/backend/circuits.py
nodes.description: P6 native circuit-tracer CLI wrapper and typed graph data preservation. Native attribution must actually run upstream. Pruning, node annotations and a drawn graph cannot stand in for the gradient computation or intervention.

nodes.title: tasks/circuits/backend/clt_intervene.py
nodes.description: Execute a real Gemma Scope 2 CLT feature edit across downstream model layers. This changes live PyTorch module outputs, not just a saved graph JSON or cross-layer decoder tensor. Requires exact input/output site mappings and the original model/transcoder identity. No arbitrary pickles are loaded.

nodes.title: tasks/circuits/operation.py
nodes.description: Concrete circuits task implementation; SAEBase supplies reusable primitives.

nodes.title: tasks/circuits/task.py
nodes.description: SAEBase circuits task.

nodes.title: tasks/explain/__init__.py
nodes.description: explain registered task.

nodes.title: tasks/explain/interpretation.py
nodes.description: Explicitly authorized explanation candidates with disjoint held-out checks. This does not pretend there is a built-in LLM interpretation model or paid service. The researcher supplies a generator and, optionally, a predictor; the output is a provenance-bearing hypothesis requiring human publication approval and further scientific validation.

This slow, unambiguous reference is an acceptance oracle for future high-speed vLLM/NNsight or cached-decoding implementations, not a performance claim.

A native pyvene execution can be supplied via its original implementation.
